verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk or batch operations, either through the API or in the UI. The cited material covers OAuth, single-resource API fields, and per-transaction automation such as smart categorisation and Smart Capture, which are adjacent automation features rather than bulk actions across many items. Bulk operations are a fair axis for accounting SaaS, so the absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
